source: Derived from the live quanti.cz stylesheet (2026-11). Not an official brand manual.

magenta.use: Accent and logo mark. Highlights, key numbers, one call to action per slide.

magenta-dark.use: Magenta on hover or pressed; never a second accent.

purple.use: Dark surfaces: title and section slides, cover pages, footers.

black.use: Body text and headings on light backgrounds.

logo.color: quanti-logo.svg / quanti-logo.png (magenta mark, black wordmark) on light backgrounds
logo.white: quanti-logo-white.svg / quanti-logo-white.png on purple, magenta or photos
logo.clearSpace: the height of the hexagon mark on every side
